propositions: Monkeypatching anthropic.AsyncAnthropic with function objects before pydantic_ai.providers.anthropic is first imported causes TypeError when the provider module evaluates its runtime TypeAlias union at lines 34-36.
Test-double representation defect causes import-time failure instead of reaching intended production auth validation that should occur before client construction.
Function-shaped monkeypatch replacements must be replaced with class-shaped doubles that preserve the SDK symbol contract to enable lazy-import isolation without pre-importing the provider module.

Three auth held-out test nodes in test_rp04_s4_llm_runtime_heldout.py at lines 41, 60, and 125 contained function-shaped AsyncAnthropic patches that prevented the secret-redaction contract from being exercised.
